ब: ब The twenty-third consonant of the Nāgari Alphābet, corresponding to the letter B, and often confounded with the analogous semi-vowel व or V, with which some grammarians consider it to be at all times optionally interchangeable.
ब m. (बः) 	 1. A name of VARUṆA. 	 2. A water jar. 	 3. Ocean. 	 4. The vulva.  E. बण् to sound, &c. aff. ड ।
बंहिष्ठ: बंहिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very much, excessively many.  E. बहु much, इष्ठन् superlative aff. form irr.
बंहीयस्: बंहीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-य) Very many.  E. बहु much, ईयमुन् superlative aff.
बठ: बठ r. 1st cl. (बठति) To be large, powerful, or able: better also वठ् ।
बडवा: बडवा f. (-वा) 	 1. A mare. 	 2. A female slave. 	 3. The nymph AŚHWINI, or the personified asterism which is designated by a horse's head. E. बल strength or force, and वा to go to, affs. क and टाप्, and ल change to ड ।
बडवाकृ: बडवाकृ(हृ)त m. (-तः) The gallant of a female slave, and thence also a slave.  E. बडवा and कृत or हृत taken.
बडवाग्नि: बडवाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Submarine fire: see the next.  E. बडवा a mare, and अग्नि fire.
बडवानल: बडवानल m. (-लः) Submarine fire; in mythology, a being consisting of flame, but with the head of a mare, who sprang from the thighs of OURVĀ, and was received by the ocean.  E. बडवा a mare, and अनल fire.
बडवामुख: बडवामुख m. (-खः) Submarine fire: see बडवानल. 	 n. (-लं) The infernal regions.  E. वडबा a mare, and मुख head, principal.
बडवासुत: बडवासुत m. dual. (-तौ) The two sons of AŚHWINĪ and the physicians of heaven.  E. बडवा the nymph AŚHWINĪ and सुत a son.
बण: बण r. 1st cl. (बणति) To sound; better also वण ।
बण m. (-णः) Sound, noise.  E. बण् to sound, aff. अच् ।
बणिक्पथ: बणिक्पथ n. (-थं) Traffic, commerce.  E. बनिज् and पथ् for पथिन् a path.
बणिक्पत्त्र: बणिक्पत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of a merchant or a young merchant or trader. 	 f. (-त्त्री) A young woman of the same tribe.  E. बणिज् and पुत्त्र a son.
बणिग्बन्धु: बणिग्बन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.)  E. बणिज् a trader, and बन्धु the friend.
बणिग्भाव: बणिग्भाव n. (-वं) Traffic, trade, commerce.  E. बणिज् a trader, and भाव property.
बणिग्वह: बणिग्वह m. (-हः) A camel.  E. बणिज् a trader, वह who bears.
बणिज्: बणिज् m. (-णिक्) 	 1. A merchant, a trader. 	 2. The sixth of the astro-nomical periods called Karanas, corresponding to the half of a lunar day. 	 f. (-णिक्) Trade, traffic.  E. पण् to transact business, इजि Unādi aff. and ब substituted for प; also बणिज ।
बणिज्य: बणिज्य nf. (-ज्यं-ज्या) Trade, traffic.  E. बणिज् a trader, य aff.
बद: बद r. 1st cl. (बदति) To be steady or firm. r. 1st and 10th cls. (बदति-ते बादयति-ते) 	 1. To speak. 	 2. To declare or communicate informa-tion; in these two senses, the root is more commonly and correct-ly written वद ।
बदर: बदर mf. (-रः-री) 	 1. The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba or scandens.) 	 m. (-रः) The seed of the cotton pod. 	 f. (-रा-री) Cotton. 	 f. (-रा) 	 1. A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) 	 2. A medicinal drug, commonly Varāhakrānti. n. (-रं) 	 1. The fruit of the jujube. 	 2. The berry or pod of the cot-ton.  E. बद् to be firm, Unādi aff. अरच्; or if derived from वद् to give information; it is read by some authorities वदर ।
बदरप: बदरप (पा) चन n. (-नं) Name of a sacred bathing place.
बदरामलक: बदरामलक m. (-कः) A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)  E. बदर the jujube, आमलक myrobalan.
बदरि: बदरि m. (-रिः) The jujube: see बदर.  E. बद्द् to be firm, aff. अरि ।
बदरिकाश्रम: बदरिकाश्रम m. (-मः) The hermitage at Badarikā.
बदरी: बदरी f. (-रीः) 	 1. The jujube tree. 	 2. A name of one of the sources of the Ganges and the hermitage of Nara and Nārāyana.  E. बदर, ङीष् aff.
बदरीच्छदा: बदरीच्छदा f. (-दा) 	 1. A kind of perfume, apparently a dried shell fish. 2. A tree, apparently a species of the zizyphus.  E. बदर the juju-be, छद a leaf.
बदरीपत्रक: बदरीपत्रक n. (-कं) A sort of perfume, a leaf.  E. बदरी the jujube, पत्र a leaf, and कन् aff. of comparison added.
बदरीफला: बदरीफला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly blue Śephālikā or nyctanthes. E. बदरी the jujube, फल fruit.
बदरीशैल: बदरीशैल n. (-लं) A part of the Himālaya range, and a celebrated place of pilgrimage; the Badrināth of modern travellers, or a town and temple on the west bank of the Alakānanda river, in the province of Srinagar.  E. बदरी the jujube and शैल mountain; also बदरीवन n. (-नं) The wood of jujubes, &c.
बद्ध: बद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound, tied. 	 2. Checked, suppressed. 	 3. Fixed, firm. 	 4. Withheld. 	 5. Captured. 	 6. Confined. 	 7. United. 	 8. Dis-played. 	 9. Cherished.  E. बन्ध् to bind, aff. क्त, form irr.
बद्धकक्ष: बद्धकक्ष Adj. Having the girdle girt up, prepared, ready.
बद्धकोप: बद्धकोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 	 1. One who governs or suppresses wrath. 	 2. Smothering resentment.  E. वद्ध and कोप passion.
बद्धमूल: बद्धमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Fast or firmly rooted.  E. बद्ध, and मूल the root.
बद्धशिख: बद्धशिख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Young, a pupil, a child, one whose hair has not been shaven. 	 f. (-खा) A sort of pungent root, a kind of garlic.  E. बद्ध tied, and शिखा a crest or lock of hair, &c.
बद्धाञ्जलि: बद्धाञ्जलि mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि) Saluting respectfully, putting the hands joined to the forehead.  E. बद्ध attached, अञ्जलि the palms joined and touching the forehead.
बद्धानुशय: बद्धानुशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Of fixed intent. 	 2. Taking aim.  E. बद्ध, and अनुशय purpose.
बध: बध r. 1st cl. (वीभत्सते) 	 1. To bind or tie. 	 2. To hate, to despise, to loathe. 3. To suffer change or affection of the mind. r. 1st and 10th cls. (बधति-बाधयति-ते) 	 1. To tie, to bind. 	 2. To kill.
बध m. (-धः) 	 1. Killing, slaughter, slaying, murder. 	 2. A killer, a slau-ghter.  E. बध् substituted for हन् to kill, aff. घञ् ।
बधक: बधक m. (-कः) A slaughterer, a killer.  E. हन् changed to बध and कुन् aff.
बधकाङ्क्षिन्: बधकाङ्क्षिन् mfn. (-ङ्क्षी-ङ्क्षिणी-ङ्खि) Wishing death.  E. बध and काङ्क्षिन् who wishes.
बधकाम्या: बधकाम्या f. (-म्या) Intent or desire to kill.  E. बध and काम्या desire.
बधजीविन्: बधजीविन् m. (-वी) A hunter, a fowler, a butcher. &c.  E. बध killing, and जीविन् who lives by.
बधत्र: बधत्र n. (-त्रं) A weapon.  E. बध् to kill, Unādi aff. अत्रन् ।
बधदण्ड: बधदण्ड n. (-ण्डं) Capital punishment.  E. बध and दण्ड punishment.
बधस्थली: बधस्थली f. (-ली) A place of slaughter or execution.  E. बध killing, स्थल ground.
बधस्थान: बधस्थान n. (-नं) Place of slaughter or execution.  E. बध killing, स्थान place.
बधाङ्गक: बधाङ्गक n. (-कं) 	 1. Poison. 	 2. Prison.  E. बध killing, अङ्ग the body, aff. कन् ।
बधार्ह: बधार्ह mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) Deserving death.  E. बध and अर्ह fit for.
बधिर: बधिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Deaf.  E. बन्ध् to bind, (the hearing.) aff. किरच्, deriv. irr.
बधू: बधू f. (-धूः) 	 1. A woman. 	 2. A wife.  E. बन्ध् to bind, aff. ऊ; it is more usually derived from वह् to bear, and is consequently written with the semi-vowel: see वधू &c.
बधोदर्क: बधोदर्क mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-कं) Effecting or causing death,  E. बध, and उदरक future result.
बधोद्यत: बधोद्यत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Murderous, felonious, an assassin, a murderer. E. बध killing, and उद्यत endeavouring.
बधोपाय: बधोपाय m. (-यः) Instrument or means of putting to death.  E. बध, and उपाय means.
बध्य: बध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 	 1. Deserving death. 	 2. Condemned to death. E. बध् for हन् to kill, aff. यत् ।
बध्यता: बध्यता f. (-ता) 	 1. Destruction. 	 2. Fitness to be killed.  E. बध्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, बध्यत्वं.
बध्यभूमि: बध्यभूमि f. (-मिः) Place of public execution.  E. बध्य and भूमि site.
बध्यस्थान: बध्यस्थान n. (-नं) Place of execution.  E. बध्य, and स्थान place.
बद्धा: बद्धा Ind. 	 1. Having tied or bound. 	 2. Having killed.  E. बन्ध् to tie, or बध् to kill, and क्त्वाच् aff.
बध्र: बध्र n. (-ध्रं) Lead. 	 f. (-ध्री) A thong.  E. वन्ध् to bind, aff. ष्ट्रन्; see वर्द्ध and वर्द्धी ।
बध्र्य: बध्र्य n. (-ध्र्यं) A shoe, a slipper.  E. बन्ध् to bind or tie, ष्ट्रान् aff.
बन: बन (उ) (बनु) r. 8th cl. (बनुते) To ask or beg, preferably written वन ।
बन्ध: बन्ध r. 9th. cl. (बध्नाति) r. 10th cl. (बन्धयति-ते) To bind or tie; with आङ् prefixed. To loosen, to let loose. With अनु, 1. To follow. 	 2. To be affixed or attached to. With नि, to disunite. With सम्, to connect.

बन्ध m. (-न्धः) 	 1. A pledge, a deposit. 	 2. A binding, a tie or fetter, &c. 3. Binding, tying. 	 4. The body. 	 5. Joining. 	 6. Forming. 	 7. A li-gature, a bandage. 	 8. Connection, intercourse. 	 9. Agreement, union. 	 10. Result. 	 11. Border, frame-work. 	 12. The body. 	 13. Manifestation, display. 	 14. Bondage, (opposite to annihilation.) 15. A posture. 	 16. The different forms of sexual intercourse men-tioned in Kāma Shāstra. 	 17. Feeling. 	 18. Laying snares. 	 19. A stanza which can be arranged in a particular shape, as “Padma bandha,” &c.  E. बन्ध् to tie, aff. अच् ।
बन्धक: बन्धक n. (-कं) 	 1. Exchanging, barter. 	 2. A city. 	 3. A binding, 4. Bind-ing, confinement. 	 m. (-कः) A pledge. 	 f. (-की) 	 1. An unchaste wo-man, a harlot, a wanton. 	 2. A barren woman. 	 3. A she-elephant, E. बन्ध् to bind, ण्वुल् aff. fem. aff. ङीष् ।
बन्धतन्त्र: बन्धतन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A complete army, or one with its four divisions, of chari-ots, elephants, horse and foot.  E. बन्ध् binding, तन्त्र an army.
बन्धन: बन्धन n. (-नं) 	 1. Binding, tying, confining. 	 2. A rope for tying cattle. 3. Killing. 	 4. Hurting, injuring. 	 mfn. Subst. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) The implement of binding or tying, a rope, a chain, a bandage, a liga-ture, &c.  E. बन्ध् to tie, aff. ल्युट् or युच् ।
बन्धनग्रन्थि: बन्धनग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 	 1. A rope for tying cattle. 	 2. The knot of a ligature. E. बन्धन tying, and ग्नन्थि a knot.
बन्धनरज्जु: बन्धनरज्जु f. (-ज्जुः) 	 1. A rope for tying cattle, &c. 	 2. Any rope or string used for tying.  E. बन्धन tying, रज्जु a rope.
बन्धनवेश्मन्: बन्धनवेश्मन् n. (-श्म) A prison.  E. बन्धन confinement, and वेश्मन् a house.
बन्धनालय: बन्धनालय m. (-यः) A prison.  E. बन्धन confinement and आलय abode.
बन्धस्तम्भ: बन्धस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) The post to which an elephant is tied.  E. बन्ध् a bind-ing and स्तम्भ a post.
बन्धित्र: बन्धित्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Love, desire. 	 2. A leathern fan.  E. बन्ध् to bind, इत्र Unādi aff.
बन्धु: बन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 	 1. A kinsman, a relation, but especially a distant or cog-nate kinsman, and subsequent in right of inheritance to the gen-tile or Sagotra; the Bandhu, is of three kinds; the kinsman of the person himself, of his father or his mother, as his father's brother's son, and his mother's sister's or brother's son; and the same reckoning upwards, as his father's father's sister's son, &c. 2. A friend. 	 3. A brother. 	 4. A flower, (Pentapetes phœnicea.) E. बन्ध् to bind or connect, (in affection.) उ aff.
बन्धुक: बन्धुक m. (-कः) A flower: see बन्धूक ।
बन्धुजन: बन्धुजन m. (-नः) A relation, a friend.  E. बन्धु, and जन a person.
बन्धुजीव: बन्धुजीव m. (-वः) A flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea.)  E. बन्धु a friend, जीव् to live, aff. अच्; also कन् being added, बन्धुजीवक m. (-कः).
बन्धुता: बन्धुता f. (-ता) 	 1. A multitude of relations. 	 2. Relationship.  E. बन्धु a kinsman, and तल् aff.
बन्धुत्व: बन्धुत्व n. (-त्वं) Relationship.  E. बन्धु and त्व aff.; also with तल् बन्धुता ।
बन्धुदत्त: बन्धुदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given by a kinsman. 	 n. (-त्तं) One kind of fe-male property, that given to a girl at her marriage by her own relations.  E. बन्धु and दत्त given.
बन्धुर: बन्धुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Uneven, undulating, wavy, partially even and de-pressed. 	 2. Bowed, bent. 	 3. Pleasing, delightful, handsome, beauti-ful. 	 4. Deaf. 	 5. Injurious, mischievous. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A goose. 	 2. A flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea.) 	 3. A drug, commonly Biranga. 	 4. A bird. 	 5. A crane. 	 6. A drug, commonly Rishabha. 	 7. The vulva. n. (-रं) 	 1. A diadem, a crest. 	 2. The dregs of oil, or oil-cake. 	 3. A hole. 	 f. (-रा) A whore, a prostitute. 	 f. plu. (-राः) The meal of parched corn.  E. बन्ध् to bind, उरच् Unādi aff.; also with ऊरच् aff. बन्धूर ।
बन्धुल: बन्धुल f. (-ला) 	 1. Bent, inclined. 	 2. Attractive. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A bastard. 2. An attendant in the chamber of a harlot. 	 3. The Bandhuka tree.
बन्धुहीन: बन्धुहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Friendless, relationless.  E. बन्धु and हीन devoid of.
बन्धूक: बन्धूक m. (-कः) 	 1. A shrub bearing a red flower, (Pentapetes Phœnicea, but also applied to the Ixora Bandhūca.) 	 2. A tree, (Pentaptera.) 3. A bastard.  E. बन्ध् to bind, ऊक aff.
बन्धूकपुष्प: बन्धूकपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)  E. बन्धूक the Penta-petes or Ixora and पुष्प flower; having a similar flower.
बन्धूर: बन्धूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Wavy, undulating, uneven. 	 2. Bowing, bent. 3. Beautiful, handsome. 	 m. (-रः) A hole, a chasm.  E. बन्ध् to bind, Unādi aff. ऊरच्; also बन्धुर ।
बन्धूलि: बन्धूलि m. (-लिः) A flower, (Pentapetes, &c.): see बन्धूक.  E. बन्ध् and ऊलिच् aff.
बन्ध्य: बन्ध्य mfn. (-न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं) 	 1. Barren, unfruitful, not bearing fruit in due season. 	 2. Detained, confined, under arrest. 	 f. (-न्ध्या) 	 1. A child-less woman. 	 2. A barren cow. 	 3. A perfume, commonly Bālā. E. बन्ध् to bind, aff. यत् ।
बभूवस्: बभूवस् mfn. (-वान्-भूषी-वः) Been, become.  E. भू to be, बसु aff.
बभ्र: बभ्र r. 1st cl. (बभ्रति) To go; also वभ्र ।
बभ्रवी: बभ्रवी f. (-वी) A name of DURGĀ.  E. बभ्रु SIVA, and ङीप् aff.
बभ्रि: बभ्रि mfn. (-भ्रिः-भ्रिः-भ्रि) Who or what has, holds, possesses, &c.  E. भृ to cherish, किन् aff.
बभ्रु: बभ्रु mfn. (-भ्रुः-भ्रुः or -भ्रूः-भ्रु) 	 1. Large, great. 	 2. Tawny, &c. 	 3. Bald-headed through disease. 	 m. (-भ्रुः) 	 1. A name of VISHṆU. 	 2. SĪVA. 3. AGNI or fire. 	 4. A large ichneumon. 	 5. The name of a Muni or holy sage. 	 6. A rat. 	 n. (-भ्रु) 	 1. A tawny or brown colour. 	 2. Any object of that colour.  E. भृ to fill, aff. कु, and the initial repeated; or बभ्र, उ aff.
बम्भर: बम्भर m. (-रः) A bee.  E. बम्भ् imitative sound, रा to make, क aff.
बम्भराली: बम्भराली f. (-ली) A fly.  E. बम्भ् imitative sound, रा to make, लच् aff.: also भम्भराली ।
बर: बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Best, excellent. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A boon, a blessing, &c. 2. A Son-in-law. 	 3. Surrounding, encompassing. 	 4. A catamite. 	 n. (-र) Saffron. 	 m. (-रः) Asparagus racemosus. 	 f. (-रा) The three my-robalans. 	 n. or ind. (-रं) Slightly desired, preferable.  E. बॄ, to select, &c. अच् aff.; the root is more usually written वॄ, and the derivative वर, q. v.
बर्बट: बर्ब्बट mf. (-टः-टी) A sort of bean, (Dolichos catjang.) “बरबटी” f. (-टी) A whore.  E. बर्ब्ब् to go, अट् aff.

बहुतर: बहुतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Much, many, most.  E. तरप् aff. added to बहु ।
बहुतस्: बहुतस् Ind. From or by much, or many.  E. बहु much, तसि aff.
बहुतिथ: बहुतिथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Manieth, (the ordinary of many.)  E. बहु many, much, इट् aff. and तिथुक् augment.
बहुत्र: बहुत्र Ind. In many ways, or places, &c.  E. बहु much, many, त्रल् aff.
बहुत्व: बहुत्व n. (-त्वं) Plurality, multitude, muchness, abundance.  E. बहु much, त्व aff. of the abstract.
बहुत्वक्क: बहुत्वक्क m. (-क्कः) The Bhurja-patra or Birch-tree.  E. बहु much, त्वच् skin or bark, कन् aff.; having several layers of bark.
बहुत्वच्: बहुत्वच् m. (-त्वक्) The Bhurja-patra, or Birch tree.  E. बहु much, and त्वच् bark: see the last.
बहुद: बहुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Liberal, munificent.  E. बहु, and द who gives.
बहुदक्षिण: बहुदक्षिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 	 1. Accompanied with many presents, (a cere-mony.) 	 2. Liberal, bountiful.  E. बहु, and दक्षिणा a gift.
बहुदण्डिक: बहुदण्डिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having many staff-bearers, &c.  E. बहु many, दण्डिन् having a staff, कन् aff.; also in the masculine form बहु-दण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी).
बहुदुग्ध: बहुदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) Wheat. 	 f. (-ग्धा) A cow giving much milk.  E. बहु much and दुग्ध milk.
बहुदुग्धिका: बहुदुग्धिका f. (-का) A plant, yielding a caustic milky juice, (Euphor-bia, of various sorts.)  E. बहु much. दुग्ध milk, कन् aff.; fem. form.
बहुदृष्ट: बहुदृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Experienced.  E. बहु, and दृष्ट seen.
बहुदोष: बहुदोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Full of faults or defects, very wicked, very bad. E. बहु and दोष fault.
बहुधन: बहुधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wealthy, rich.  E. वहु, and धन wealth.
बहुधा: बहुधा Ind. In many ways. sorts, &c.  E. बहु much, धाच् aff.
बहुधागत: बहुधागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dispersed, scattered.  E. बहुधा, and गत gone.
बहुधार: बहुधार m. (-रः) INDRA'S thunderbolt.  E. बहु many, धारा edge.
बहुनाद: बहुनाद m. (-दः) The conch-shell.  E. बहु much, नाद sound.
बहुपटु: बहुपटु mfn. (-टुः-ट्वी-टु) Very clever.  E. बहु much, and पटु clever.
बहुपत्र: बहुपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री त्रं) Many-leaved. 	 m. (-त्रः) An onion. 	 n. (-त्रं) Talc. 	 f. (-त्री) A drug, (Trigonella fœnugræcum.)  E. बहु many, पत्र a leaf, &c.
बहुपर्णी: बहुपर्णी f. (र्णी) A medicinal plant, (Trigonella fœnugræcum.)  E. बहु many, पर्ण a leaf.
बहुपाद्: बहुपाद् m. (-पाद्) The Indian fig-tree.  E. बहु many, पाद foot: also बहुपाद m. (-दः) Alluding to the branches, which grow down-wards and take root again.
बहुपुत्त्र: बहुपुत्त्र mfn. (-त्त्रः-त्त्री-त्त्रं) Having many children. 	 m. (-त्त्रः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 	 f. (-त्त्री) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)  E. बहु many, पुत्त्र a child or produce.
बहुप्रज: बहुप्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having a numerous progeny. 	 m. (-जः) 	 1. A hog. 	 2. A sort of grass: see मुञ्ज.  E. बहु many, प्रजा offspring.
बहुप्रतिज्ञ: बहुप्रतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 	 1. Complicated, containing more than one circumstance. 	 2. (In law.) Comprising many counts, (a plaint, &c.) E. बहु many, प्रतिज्ञा assent.
बहुप्रद: बहुप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Munificent, bountiful.  E. बहु much, and प्रद who gives.
बहुप्रवाह: बहुप्रवाह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Flowing in many streams.  E. बहु and प्रवाह course.
बहुप्रसू: बहुप्रसू f. (-सूः) The mother of many children.  E. बहु much, and प्रसू who bears offspring.
बहुफल: बहुफल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Fertile, fruitful. 	 m. (-लः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.) 	 f. (-ली) The opposite-leaved fig-tree.  E. बहु much, फल fruit.
बहुभाग्य: बहुभाग्य mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं) Fortunate.  E. बहु, and भाग्य fortune.
बहुभुज्: बहुभुज् mfn. (-भुक) Voracious.  E. वहु and भुज् who eats.
बहुमत: बहुमत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Thought much of, respected, considered. 	 2. Having many different opinions.  E. बहु and मत minded.
बहुमति: बहुमति f. (-तिः) Value, estimation, prizing or preferring.  E. बहु, and मति mind.
बहुमल: बहुमल n. (-लं) Lead.  E. बहु much, मल dirt.
बहुमार्ग: बहुमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A place where four roads meet.  E. बहु many, मार्ग a road.
बहुमान: बहुमान n. (-नं) Respect, reverence.  E. बहु, and मान respect.
बहुमूर्ति: बहुमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Multiform. 	 f. (-र्त्तिः) Wild-cotton.  E. बहु many, मूर्त्ति form.
बहुमूर्त्ति: बहुमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Multiform. 	 f. (-र्त्तिः) Wild-cotton.  E. बहु many, मूर्त्ति form.
बहुमूर्द्धन्: बहुमूर्द्धन् mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध) Many-headed. 	 m. (-र्द्धा) VISHṆU.  E. बहु many, मूर्द्धन् a forehead.
बहुमूल: बहुमूल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Many-rooted, having many roots. 	 m. (-लः) A sort of reed or grass: see इक्कट and इत्कट.  E. बहु many, and मूल a root; also with कुन् added, बहुमूलक m. (-कः).
बहुमूल्य: बहुमूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Costly, precious.  E. बहु much, and मूल price, aff. यत् ।

बहुरेखा: बहुरेखा m. plu. (-खाः) Wrinkles, furrows, marks of care or pain. E. बहु many, रेखा a line.
बहुरेतस्: बहुरेतस् m. (-ताः) BRAHMĀ.  E. बहु much, and रेतस् seed.
बहुरोमन्: बहुरोमन् m. (-मा) A sheep.  E. बहु much, and रोमन् hair.
बहुल: बहुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Much, many, 2. Black. 	 3. Variously applicable, comprehensive, (a rule, &c.) 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. AGNI or fire. 	 2. The dark half of a month. 	 n. (-लं) The sky. 	 f. plu. (-लाः). The Pleiades. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. Indigo. 	 2. Cardamoms. 	 3. A cow.  E. बहु many, ला to get, aff. क ।
बहुलत्व: बहुलत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Abundance, muchness. 	 2. Comprehensiveness, (of a rule.)  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल् aff. बहुलता ।
बहुलीकरण: बहुलीकरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Multiplying, magnifying, making much. 	 2. Win-nowing.  E. बहुल and करण making, with च्वि aug.
बहुलीकृत: बहुलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Threshed and winnowed. 	 2. Made manifold or much.  E. बहुल much, कृत made, and च्वि substituted for the final of the former, by which the ई is inserted.

बहुवार: बहुवार m. (-रः) A fruit, (Cordia myxa.)  E. बहु much, वॄ to nourish, aff. अण्; also with कन् added, बहुवारक m. (-कः) ।
बहुविध: बहुविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Various multiform, of many sorts or kinds. E. बहु many, and विध sort.
बहुविस्तीर्ण: बहुविस्तीर्ण mfn. (र्णः-र्णा-र्ण) Widely spread or diffused. 	 f. (-र्णा) A shrub bearing a small red and black berry, (Abrus precatorious.)  E. बहु much, विस्तीर्ण spreading. “कुंँच” ।
बहुवीज: बहुवीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Having many or much seed. 	 n. (-जं) The cus-tard-apple, (Annona squamosa.) “आता”  E. बहु many, and वीज a seed.
बहुवीर्य: बहुवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Beleric myrobalan. (Terminalia belerica.)  E. बहु much and वीर्य्य seed. “वहेडा”.
बहुवीर्य्य: बहुवीर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) Beleric myrobalan. (Terminalia belerica.)  E. बहु much and वीर्य्य seed. “वहेडा”.

बहुशत्रु: बहुशत्रु mfn. (-त्रुः-त्रुः-त्रु) Having many enemies. 	 m. (-त्रुः) A sparrow. E. बहु many, and शत्रु an enemy.
बहुशस्: बहुशस् Ind. Abundantly, plentifully.  E. बहु much, many, शस् aff.
बहुशाख: बहुशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Having many branches or ramifications.  E. बहु, and शाखा a branch.
बहुश्रुत: बहुश्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Well-taught, learned. 	 2. Acquainted with the Vedas.  E. बहु, and श्रुत heard, or श्रुति Vedas.
बहुश्रेयस्: बहुश्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 	 1. Having many excellencies. 	 2. Very excellent.  E. बहु, and श्रेयस् best.
बहुस्पृश्: बहुस्पृश् mfn. (-स्पृक्) Expanded, spread, diffused.  E. बहु, and स्पृश् what touches.
बहुसन्तति: बहुसन्तति m. (-तिः) A species of bamboo, (Bambusa spinosa.)  E. बहु much, सन्तति spreading.
बहुसुता: बहुसुता f. (-ता) A plant, (Asparagus.)  E. वहु many, सुत a birth or shoot. “शतमूली” ।
बहुसू: बहुसू f. (-सूः) 	 1. A sow 2. The mother of many children.  E. बहु many, and सू bearing, aff. क्विप् ।
बहुसूति: बहुसूति f. (-तिः) A cow bearing many calves.  E. बहु many, सू to bear, aff. क्तिन्.
बहुस्वन: बहुस्वन m. (-नः) An owl.  E. बहु much, स्वन noise or sound.
बहूदक: बहूदक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Having much water.  E. बहु and उदक water.

बह्वपत्य: बह्वपत्य m. (-त्यः) 	 1. A hog. 	 2. A rat. 	 f. (-त्या) A cow that has borne many calves.  E. बहु many, अपत्य offspring.
बह्वाशिन्: बह्वाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Voracious, gluttonous.  E. बहु much, आशिन् who eats.
बह्वृच्: बह्वृच् f. (-ह्वृक्) The Rig-Veda.  E. बहु many, ऋच् a hymn or prayer.
बह्वृची: बह्वृची f. (-ची) The wife of a Brāhman conversant with the Rig-Veda.  E. वहु many, ऋच् a prayer or incantation, aff. ङीप् ।

बाणिज: बाणिज m. (-जः) 	 1. A merchant, a trader. 	 2. Submarine fire.  E. बणिज्, &c. aff. अण् ।

बुद्धीन्द्रिय: बुद्धीन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An organ of intellect, as the mind, eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin.  E. बुद्धि understanding and इन्द्रिय an organ.
बुद्धुद: बुद्धुद m. (-दः) A bubble.  E. बुद् imitative sound, बुद् to perceive, aff. क ।
बुद्ध्यवज्ञान: बुद्ध्यवज्ञान n. (-नं) Disregard of or contempt for one's understanding. E. बुद्धि, and अवज्ञान disrespect.

बुधजन: बुधजन m. (-नः) A wise man.  E. बुध्, and जन a person.
बुधतात: बुधतात m. (-तः) The moon, the father of BUDDHA.
बुधवार: बुधवार m. (-रः) Wednesday,  E. बुध् MERCURY, and वार a day.
बुधसुत: बुधसुत m. (-तः) PURŪRAVAS, the first king of the lunar dynasty.  E. बुध् BUDDHA or MERCURY, and the son of SOMA, and सुत son.
बुधान: बुधान m. (-नः) 	 1. A wise man, a sage. 	 2. A holy teacher. 	 3. One who speaks kindly. 	 4. A worshipper or adorer of BRAHMĀ.  E. बुध् to know, आनच् Unādi aff.
बुधित: बुधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, understood.  E. बुध् to know, aff. क्त ।
बुधिल: बुधिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Wise, learned.  E. बुध् to know, Unādi aff. किलच् ।
बुध्न: बुध्न m. (-ध्नः) 	 1. The root of a tree. 	 2. The bottom of a vessel. 	 3. ŚIVA. E. बुध् to know, Unādi aff. नक्ः also ब्रध्न in the last sense.
बुन्द्: बुन्द् (उ, इर्) उबुन्दिर् r. 1st cl. (बुन्दति-ते) To discern, to perceive, literally or figuratively.
बुन्ध्: बुन्ध् (उ, इर्) उबुधिर् r. 1st. cl. (बुन्धति-ते) To discern, to perceive: see बुन्द ।
बुभुक्षा: बुभुक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. Hunger. 	 2. The desire of enjoyment.  E. भुज् to eat, in the desid. form, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
बुभुक्षित: बुभुक्षित mfn. (तः-ता-तं) Hungry.  E. बुभुक्षा hunger, इतच् aff.
बुभुक्षु: बुभुक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Wishing to eat.  E. भुज् to eat, desid. v., उ aff.
बुभुत्सा: बुभुत्सा f. (-त्सा) The wishing to know.  E. बुध् to know, desid, v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
बुभुत्सु: बुभुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to know.  E. बुध् to know, desid. v., उ aff.
बुभूषा: बुभूषा f. (-षा) Desire to be or become.  E. भू to be, desid. v., affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
बुभूषु: बुभूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to be or become.  E. भू to be, desid. v., उ aff.
बुभूर्षु: बुभूर्षु mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु) 	 1. Wishing to fill. 	 2. Desirous to nourish, &c. E. भृ to nourish, desid. v., उ aff.
बुल्: बुल् r. 10th cl. (बोलयति-ते) To sink, to dive, to plunge.
बुलि: बुलि f. (-लिः) 	 1. The vulva. 	 2. Fear.  E. बुल् to emerge, aff. इन् ।
बुष: बुष n. (-षं) 	 1. Chaff. 	 2. Water; also बुस.
बुस्: बुस् r. 4th cl. (बुस्यति) To dismiss, to loose, to quit or leave.
बुस: बुस n. (-सं) 	 1. Chaff. rubbish, refuse. 	 2. Wealth. 	 3. Dry cow-dung. 	 4. The thick part of sour curds. 	 f. (-सा) A younger sister, (in theatrical language.)  E. बुस् to abandon, aff. क; also बुष, स being changed to ष ।
बुस्त: बुस्त r. 10th cl. (बुस्तयति-ते) 	 1. To regard, to respect. 	 2. To disregard, to treat with disrespect.
बुस्त n. (-स्तं) 	 1. Fried meat. 	 2. The inner part of the jack fruit.  E. बुस्त to disrespect, aff. अच् ।
बूक्क: बूक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्कं) The heart; also बुक्क; also with a final न्, बूक्कन् mfn. (-क्का-क्का-क्क) also बृक्व ।
बृक्क: बृक्क mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्कं) 	 1. The heart. 	 2. The kidney. E. See the last, ऋ substituted for ऊ ।
बृशी: बृशी (षी) f. (-शी or -षी) The seat of a holy sage: also बृसी ।
बृह: बृह r. 1st cl. (बर्हति) To grow, to increase: see वृह ।
बृहत्: बृहत् mfn. (-हन् हन्ती हत्) See वृहत् ।
बॄ: बॄ r. 9th cl. (बॄणाति) 	 1. To choose or select 2. To support or nourish; also in the first sense, बॄ more usually.
बोद्धव्य: बोद्धव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 	 1. To be informed, taught, waked, &c. 	 2. Re-quiring to be taught or explained. 	 3. Necessary to be understood. E. बुध् to know, causal v., तव्य aff.
बोध: बोध m. (-धः) 	 1. Wisdom, intellect. 	 2. A wakening, arousing.  E. बुध् to understand, aff. घञ् ।

बोधकर: बोधकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who teaches, informs, awakes, &c. 	 m. (-रः) An awakener, a sort of minstrel who awakens the prince or chief in the morning, by music.  E. बोध awakening, कर who makes.
बोधन: बोधन nf. (-नं-नी) 	 1. Knowledge. 	 2. Teaching, informing. 	 3. Awaking, arousing. 	 n. (-नं) Burning incense. 	 m. (-नः) The planet MERCURY. 	 f. (-नी) Long-pepper.  E. बुध् to know, aff. ल्युट्.
बोधनीय: बोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be explained or expounded, to be rendered intelligible.  E. बुध् to know, in the causal form, aff. अनीयर् ।
बोधयत्: बोधयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Informing, apprising. 	 2. Teaching. 	 3. Arousing, waking.  E. बुध् to know, causal v., शतृ aff.
बोधि: बोधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Wise, learned. 	 m. (-धिः) 	 1. A branch of holy study; keeping the mind awake to the knowledge of the true GOD. 2. Intellect, understanding. 	 3. The holy fig-tree.  E. बुध् to know, Unādi aff. इन्.
बोधितरु: बोधितरु m. (-रुः) The holy fig-tree.  E. बोधि wisdom, and तरु the tree.
बोधिद्रुम: बोधिद्रुम m. (-मः) The holy fig-tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. बोधि know-ledge, द्रुम a tree.
बोधिसत्त्व: बोधिसत्त्व m. (-त्त्वः) A Buddha, or Bauddha saint.  E. बोधि intellect, सत्त्व truth.
बोध्य: बोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be informed, taught, waked, &c.  E. बुध् to know, causal v., यत् aff.
बौद्ध: बौद्ध m. (-द्धः) A Bauddha, or follower of the religion of the Buddhas. E. बुद्ध a Buddha, अण् aff.
बौध: बौध m. (-धः) A name of PURŪRAVAS, the son of BUDDHA, and grandson of SOMA or the moon.  E. बुध् MERCURY, and अण् aff. of descent.
ब्युष्: ब्युष् r. 4th cl. (ब्युष्यति) To burn. r. 10th cl. (ब्युषयति-ते) 	 1. To divide. 	 2. To offer in oblation.
ब्रण्: ब्रण् r. 1st cl. (ब्रणति) To sound; ब्रण more properly.
ब्रतति: ब्रतति f. (-तिः-ती) 	 1. A creeper. 	 2. Expansion.  E. प्र before, तन् to spread, aff. क्तिच्, and प changed to ब; also व्रतति.
ब्रध्न: ब्रध्न m. (-ध्नः) 	 1. The root of a tree. 	 2. The sun. 	 3. SĪVA. 	 4. BRAHMĀ. 5. A horse. 	 6. The body. 	 7. A day. 	 8. The Arka plant. 	 9. Bubo, (the disease.) 	 10. Lead.  E. बन्ध् to bind, aff. नक् and ब्रध substituted for the root.
ब्रह्मकन्यका: ब्रह्मकन्यका f. (-का) The goddesss SARASWATĪ.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and कन्या the daughter; being born from the head of that deity.
ब्रह्मगिरि: ब्रह्मगिरि m. (-रिः) A mountain.  E. ब्रह्म and गिरि a hill; the hill of BRAHMĀ.
ब्रह्यघातक: ब्रह्यघातक m. (-कः) The slayer of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and घातक who kills; also ब्रह्मघातिन् m. (-ती) ।
ब्रह्मघातिनी: ब्रह्मघातिनी f. (-नी) A woman on the second day of the menses.
ब्रह्मघ्न: ब्रह्मघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The slayer of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and घ्न who kills.
ब्रह्यचर्य्य: ब्रह्यचर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The Brahmacharya or Brahmachārī, the religious student: see ब्रह्मचारिन् n. (-र्य्यं) The order or condition of the reli-gious student.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda and चर्य्य observance.
ब्रह्मचर्यस्खलन: ब्रह्मचर्य्यस्खलन n. (-नं) Incontinence.  E. ब्रह्मचर्य्य and स्खखन deviating from.
ब्रह्मचर्य्यस्खलन: ब्रह्मचर्य्यस्खलन n. (-नं) Incontinence.  E. ब्रह्मचर्य्य and स्खखन deviating from.
ब्रह्मचारिन्: ब्रह्मचारिन् m. (-रिणी A woman leading a life of con-tinence.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda and चर् to go or follow, aff. णिनि ।

ब्रह्मजीविन्: ब्रह्मजीविन् m. (-वी) An impure Brāhman, one who converts his religious duties into a trade, and performs sacrifice, teaches the Veda, &c. for hire.  E. ब्रह्मन् an officiating priest, and जीविन् who gets a living.
ब्रह्मज्ञ: ब्रह्मज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) A sage, one who has spiritual wisdom.  E. ब्रह्म and ज्ञ who knows.
ब्रह्मज्ञान: ब्रह्मज्ञान n. (-नं) Spiritual wisdom.  E. ब्रह्म and ज्ञान knowledge.
ब्रह्मण्य: ब्रह्मण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Relating to or connected with BRAHMĀ or a Brāhman. 	 m. (-ण्यः) 	 1. The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.) 	 2. The planet SATURN.  E. ब्रह्मन् and यत् aff.
ब्रह्मतत्त्व: ब्रह्मतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The true knowledge of Supreme Spirit.  E. ब्रह्म and तत्त्व truth.
ब्रह्मत्व: ब्रह्मत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Identification with BRAHMĀ or God. 	 2. God-head. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल् aff. ब्रह्मता, or with भूय added ब्रह्मभूय n. (-यं) ।
ब्रह्मद: ब्रह्मद m. (-दः) A spiritual teacher.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda or holy knowledge, and द who gives, also ब्रह्मदातृ, ब्रह्मदायिन, &c.
ब्रह्मदण्ड: ब्रह्मदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A plant. see ब्रह्मयष्टि. 	 2. A curse, an anathema. 3. The tribute paid to a Brāhmana in the shape of a fine.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and दण्ड a stick.
ब्रह्मदत्त: ब्रह्मदत्त m. (-त्तः) One of the sovereigns of the race of Ikshwāku enumerated by the Jains.  E. ब्रह्म by or to BRAHMĀ, दत्त given.
ब्रह्मदर्भा: ब्रह्मदर्भा f. (-र्भा) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.)  E. ब्रह्म and दर्भा sacrificial grass. “यमानिकायाम् ।”
ब्रह्मदान: ब्रह्मदान n. (-नं) Instruction in the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म and दान gift.
ब्रह्मदारु: ब्रह्मदारु m. (-रुं) The mulberry, (Morus Indica.)  E. ब्रह्म and दारु wood.
ब्रह्मन्: ब्रह्मन् m. (-ह्मा) 	 1. BRAHMĀ, the first deity of the Hindu triad, and the operative creator of the world. 	 2. A Brāhman. 	 3. The superin-tending or presiding priest at the sacrifice. 	 4. One of the astrono-mical Yogas. 	 5. One of the principal servants of the Jinas. 	 n. (-ह्म) 1. The divine cause and essence of the world, from which all created things are supposed to emanate and to which they return; the unknown God. 	 2. The practice of austere devotion. 	 3. The Vedas or scripture. 	 4. Holy knowledge.  E. वृह् to increase, (man-kind) aff. मनिन् and the initial letter changed to ब ।
ब्रह्मनाभ: ब्रह्मनाभ m. (-भः) VISHṆU.  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ and नाभि the navel; BRAH-MĀ having arisen to create the world, in a lotus, which sprang from the navel of VISHṆU.
ब्रह्मनिर्वाण: ब्रह्मनिर्व्वाण n. (-णं) Absorption into or identification with the Supreme. E. ब्रह्म, and निर्व्वाण final absorption.
ब्रह्मनिर्व्वाण: ब्रह्मनिर्व्वाण n. (-णं) Absorption into or identification with the Supreme. E. ब्रह्म, and निर्व्वाण final absorption.
ब्रह्मपद: ब्रह्मपद n. (-दं) The place or nature of spiritual being. 	 2. The station or rank of a Brahman or of BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म, and पद to place.
ब्रह्मपादप: ब्रह्मपादप m. (-पः) The Palāsh tree, (Butea frondosa.)  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and पादप a tree.
ब्रह्मपुत्त्र: ब्रह्मपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 	 1. A sort of poison. 	 2. The Brahmaputra river, which rises in the Himālaya and with the Ganges falls into the Bay of Bengal. 	 2. A place of pilgrimage, probably the source of the stream. 	 f. (-त्री) 	 1. The SARASWATĪ river. 	 2. The goddess SARAS-WATĪ.  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ and पुत्त्र offspring.
ब्रह्मपुरी: ब्रह्मपुरी f. (-री) The capital of BRAHMĀ on the mountain Kailasā. E. ब्रह्मन् and पुरी the city.
ब्रह्मबन्धु: ब्रह्मबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) 	 1. The epithet or appellative of a BRĀHMAN. 	 2. A term of abuse.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and बन्धु a friend.
ब्रह्मभूत: ब्रह्मभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become one with the Supreme spirit.  E. ब्रह्म and भूत become.
ब्रह्मभूति: ब्रह्मभूति f. (-तिः) Twilight.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and भूति being.
ब्रह्मभूय: ब्रह्मभूय n. (-यं) Identification with BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, and भूय being.
ब्रह्ममय: ब्रह्ममय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Consisting of or identified with spirit. 	 2. Belong-ing to or fit for a BRĀHMAN, &c.  E. ब्रह्म and मयट् aff.
ब्रह्ममूर्द्धभृत्: ब्रह्ममूर्द्धभृत् m. (-भृत्) ŚIVA.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ, मूर्द्धन् the forehead and भृत् who has: having in a dispute cut off one of BRAHMĀ'S heads.
ब्रह्मयज्ञ: ब्रह्मयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The study of the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म a Veda or the Supreme being, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
ब्रह्मयष्टि: ब्रह्मयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen, Rox.)  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and यष्टि a stick; also with कन् added in the fem. form, ब्रह्मयष्टिका, for with ङीप् added ब्रह्मयष्टी ।
ब्रह्मयोग: ब्रह्मयोग m. (-गः) Cultivation of spiritual knowledge.  E. ब्रह्म and योग addition to.
ब्रह्मयोनि: ब्रह्मयोनि m. (-निः) A particular mountain. Adj. Sprung from BRAHMĀ. E. ब्रह्म and योनि place of production.
ब्रह्मरन्ध्र: ब्रह्मरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) An aperture in the crown of the head, through which the soul is supposed to escape.
ब्रह्मंराक्षस: ब्रह्मंराक्षस m. (-सः) A demon or fiend of the Brāhminical class.  E. ब्रह्म and राक्षम a goblin.

E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and रात्रि night.

ब्रह्मर्षि: ब्रह्मर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A divine saint, a Rishi of a particular class, including VĀSISHṬHA, &c.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and ऋषि a saint; the saints of this class are supposed to be of the Brāhminical order.
ब्रह्मर्षिदेश: ब्रह्मर्षिदेश m. (-शः) A part of India, including the four countries of Kuru-kshetra, Matsya, Panchāla, and Surasena or Mathurā. E. ब्रह्मर्षि a Rishi, देश country.
ब्रह्मलोक: ब्रह्मलोक m. (-कः) A division of the universe, the supposed eternal resi-dence of the spirits of the pious.  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ and लोक a world.
ब्रह्मवद्य: ब्रह्मवद्य n. (-द्यं) Knowledge or declaration of BRAHMĀ, the knowledge of the universal permeation of one spirit, as taught by the Vedānta system of philosophy. E. BRAHMĀ or the spiritual deity, वद् to speak or declare, aff. क्यप्, also with the aff. यत्, and the semi-vowel changed, ब्रह्मोद्य n. (-द्यं).
ब्रह्मवर्चस्: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) The power or sanctity of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and वर्च्चस् splendour.
ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस् n. (-र्च्चः) The power or sanctity of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and वर्च्चस् splendour.
ब्रह्मवर्चस: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस n. (-सं) 	 1. Holiness, resulting from the study and observance of the Vedas. 	 2. The sanctity or superhuman power of a Brāh-man.  E. ब्रह्म the Velas, and वर्च्चस splendour, aff. अच् ।
ब्रह्मवर्च्चस: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस n. (-सं) 	 1. Holiness, resulting from the study and observance of the Vedas. 	 2. The sanctity or superhuman power of a Brāh-man.  E. ब्रह्म the Velas, and वर्च्चस splendour, aff. अच् ।

ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्विन्: ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 	 1. Endowed with sanctity, pure, pious. 2. Having Brāhminical power or virtue.  E. ब्रह्मवर्च्चस्, and विनि aff.
ब्रह्मवर्त: ब्रह्मवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A district of western India; also ब्रह्मावर्त्त.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and वृत् to abide, aff. अच् ।
ब्रह्मवर्त्त: ब्रह्मवर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A district of western India; also ब्रह्मावर्त्त.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and वृत् to abide, aff. अच् ।
ब्रह्मवर्द्धन: ब्रह्मवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Copper.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and वर्द्धन increasing, favour-ing; being highly proper for utensils of worship. &c.
ब्रह्मवाद: ब्रह्मवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Citing the Vedas. 	 2. Declaring or teaching spiritual knowledge.  E. ब्रह्म scripture, and वाद speaking.
ब्रह्मवादिन्: ब्रह्मवादिन् m. (-दी) 	 1. A follower of the Vedānta system of philosophy, one who maintains all things are spirit. 	 2. A defender or ex-pounder of the Veda.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda or BRAHMĀ, GOD, and वादिन् who recites.
ब्रह्मविद्: ब्रह्मविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) A sage, one who knows the nature of the Supreme Spirit.  E. ब्रह्म and विद् who knows.
ब्रह्मविद्या: ब्रह्मविद्या f. (-द्या) Knowledge of spirit.  E. ब्रह्म, and विद्या science.
ब्रह्मविन्दु: ब्रह्मविन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A drop of saliva sputtered out in reading the Vedas. E. ब्रह्म scripture, and विन्दु a drop.
ब्रह्मवृक्ष: ब्रह्मवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. The Palāsh tree, (Butea frondosa.) 	 2. The glomer-ulus fig-tree.  E. ब्रह्म a BRAHMĀ and वृक्ष a tree.
ब्रह्मवृन्दा: ब्रह्मवृन्दा f. (-न्द्रा) The capital of BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्मन् and वृन्द heap, assemblage.
ब्रह्मवेद: ब्रह्मवेद m. (-दः) 	 1. Knowledge of BRAHMĀ, monotheism. 	 2. Knowledge of the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and वेद knowing.
ब्रह्मवेदि: ब्रह्मवेदि f. (-दिः) A country. see ब्रह्मावर्त्त.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and बेदि a country.
ब्रह्मवेदिन्: ब्रह्मवेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Knowing or acquainted with the Vedas, with spiritual knowledge, &c.  E. ब्रह्म and वेदिन् who knows.
ब्रह्मशल्य: ब्रह्मशल्य m. (-ल्यः) A tree, (Mimosa Arabica.)  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman, and शल्य a stake. “वाव्ला” ।
ब्रह्मशासन: ब्रह्मशासन n. (-नं) An edict or grant, &c. addressed to Brāhmans.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and शासन governing or an edict, &c.
ब्रह्मसत्र: ब्रह्मसत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Study and teaching of the Vedas. 	 2. The constant study of them.  E. ब्रह्म and सत्र sacrifice.
ब्रह्मसर्प: ब्रह्मसर्प m. (-र्पः) A sort of snake.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सर्प a snake.
ब्रह्मसम्भव: ब्रह्मसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from BRAHMĀ. 	 m. (-वः) The second of the persons called VĀSUDEVA or KRISHṆA by the Jains. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सम्भव offspring.
ब्रह्मसायुज्य: ब्रह्मसायुज्य n. (-ज्यं) Identification with BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सायुज्य intimate union.
ब्रह्मसार्ष्टिता: ब्रह्मसार्ष्टिता f. (-ता) Equality with BRAHMĀ.  E. ब्रह्म and सार्ष्टिता sameness.
ब्रह्मसुवर्चला: ब्रह्मसुवर्च्चला f. (-ला) A plant, an infusion of which is to be drank in ex-piation of having anything touched by a dog, cat, &c.  E. ब्रह्म, and सुवर्च्चला linseed.
ब्रह्मसुवर्च्चला: ब्रह्मसुवर्च्चला f. (-ला) A plant, an infusion of which is to be drank in ex-piation of having anything touched by a dog, cat, &c.  E. ब्रह्म, and सुवर्च्चला linseed.
ब्रह्मसू: ब्रह्मसू m. (-सूः) 	 1. ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMA. 	 2. KĀMADEVA.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सू the son.
ब्रह्मसूत्र: ब्रह्मसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. The sacrificial or Brāhminical thread. 	 2. An aphor-ism of the Vedānta philosophy.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman and सूत्र thread.
ब्रह्मसूनु: ब्रह्मसूनु m. (-नुः) A sovereign according to the Jains, of the race of Iksh-wāku.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and सूनु son.
ब्रह्मस्वरूप: ब्रह्मस्वरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Of the nature of spirit, of the same essence as the God-head.  E. ब्रह्म and स्वरूप nature.
ब्रह्महत्या: ब्रह्महत्या f. (-त्या) 	 1. Brāhminicide, killing a Brāhman. 	 2. Any crime equally heinous.  E. ब्रह्म and हत्या killing.
ब्रह्महन्: ब्रह्महन् m. (-हा) The murderer or slayer of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्मन् and हन् who kills.
ब्रह्महुत: ब्रह्महुत n. (-तं) The performance of hospitality, &c., that one of the great sacraments which consists in the veneration of mankind. E. ब्रह्म a Brāhman हुत worshipped; being the most worthy of res-pect, &c.
ब्रह्माक्षर: ब्रह्माक्षर m. (-रः) The sacred and mysterious name of the deity.  E. ब्रह्म GOD, अक्षर a letter, the Omkāra.
ब्रह्माञ्जलि: ब्रह्माञ्जलि m. (-लिः) 	 1. Joining both hands together, whilst reading the Vedas, either as an act of humility or to mark the accentuation of the Sāma-Veda. 	 2. Paying obeisance to the spiritual preceptor at the beginning or end of a lecture.  E. ब्रह्म the Vedas and अञ्चलि the hands joined.
ब्रह्माणी: ब्रह्माणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The female energy of BRAHMĀ. 	 2. A sort of perfume, commonly Renukā. 	 3. A kind of brass; “वेङापितल” ।  E. ब्रह्मन् BRAHMĀ, fem. aff. ङीप्.
ब्रह्माण्ड: ब्रह्माण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. The globe, the world. 	 2. One of the Purānas.  E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and अण्ड an egg, to which it is compared; in creation there are said to have been innumerable Brahmāndas.
ब्रह्माधिगमन: ब्रह्माधिगमन n. (-नं) Perusal of the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म and अघिगमन going through; also ब्रह्माधिगम ।
ब्रह्माधिगामिक: ब्रह्माधिगामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or contributing to a course of sacred study.  E. ब्रह्माधिगम and ठञ् aff.
ब्रह्माभ्यास: ब्रह्माभ्यास m. (-सः) Study or repetition of scripture.  E. ब्रह्म and अभ्यास exercise.
ब्रह्माम्भस्: ब्रह्माम्भस् n. (-म्भं) Cow's urine.  E. ब्रह्मन् a Brāhman and अम्भस् water.
ब्रह्मारण्य: ब्रह्मारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A place where the Vedas are read and explained. E. ब्रह्म the Veda and अरण्य a wood.
ब्रह्मावर्त: ब्रह्मावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The country to the north-west of Delhi, lying between the rivers Saraswatī and Drishadwati.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāh-man आवर्त्त abode.
ब्रह्मावर्त्त: ब्रह्मावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The country to the north-west of Delhi, lying between the rivers Saraswatī and Drishadwati.  E. ब्रह्म a Brāh-man आवर्त्त abode.
ब्रह्मासन: ब्रह्मासन n. (-नं) A posture suited to devout and religious meditation. E. ब्रह्म BRAHMĀ and आसन sitting.
ब्रह्मास्त्र: ब्रह्मास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The BRAHMĀ'S weapon, a fabulous weapon originally from BRAHMĀ. 	 2. The imprecation of a Brāhman.  E. ब्रह्म and अस्त्र a weapon.
ब्रह्माहूति: ब्रह्माहूति f. (-तिः) An oblation of ghee.  E. ब्रह्म the Veda, and आहूति an offering.
ब्रह्मो: ब्रह्मो f. (-ह्मी) 	 1. A sort of fish, commonly Pāncāl, (Macrognathus Pan-calus, HAM.) 	 2. A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. वृह् to grow or increase, affs. मनिन् and ङीप्; also ब्राह्मी.
ब्रह्मोज्झता: ब्रह्मोज्झता f. (-ता) Neglecting or forgetting the Veda.  E. ब्रह्म, उज्झता abandonment.
ब्रह्मोद्य: ब्रह्मोद्य n. (-द्यं) Reciting or explaining the Vedas.  E. ब्रह्म, वद् to speak, aff. क्यप् ।
ब्रह्मौदन: ब्रह्मौदन n. (-नं) Boiled-rice distributed to priests at a sacrifice.  E. ब्रह्मन् a Brāhman and ओदन boiled-rice.

ब्राह्मणचाण्डाल: ब्राह्मणचाण्डाल m. (-लः) An outcaste Brāhman, one who is attended by a wife of another caste or the son of a Sudra by a Brāhman female. E. ब्राह्मण and चाण्डाल an outcaste.
ब्राह्मणजाति: ब्राह्मणजाति f. (-तिः) The Brāhminical tribe or caste.  E. ब्राह्मण and जाति tribe.

ब्राह्मणजीविका: ब्राह्मणजीविका f. (-का) The occupation or subsistence of a Brāhman. E. ब्राह्मण and जीविका livelihood.
ब्राह्मणता: ब्राह्मणता f. (-ता) Brāhmanhood.  E. ब्राह्मण and तल् aff.; also with त्व, ब्राह्मणत्वं ।
ब्राह्मणबध: ब्राह्मणबध m. (-धः) Brāhminicide.  E. ब्राह्मण and बध killing.
ब्राह्मणब्रुव: ब्राह्मणब्रुव m. (-वः) A Brāhman by birth but not by attention to his du-ties; one who subsists by avocations properly limited to the other tribes.  E. ब्राह्मण a Brāhman and ब्रुव who speaks, who calls himself, (improperly.) a Brāhman.
ब्राह्मणयष्टिका: ब्राह्मणयष्टिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. ब्राह्मण a Brāh-man and यष्टि a staff, aff. कन् । “वामनहाटी” ।

ब्राह्मणहित: ब्राह्मणहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suitable to or fit for a Brāhman.  E. ब्राह्मण and हित proper.

ब्राह्मणाभ्युपपत्ति: ब्राह्मणाभ्युपपत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The protection of a Brāhman. E. ब्राह्मण and अभ्युपपत्ति defence.
ब्राह्मणायण: ब्राह्मणायण m. (-णः) A Brāhman, sprung from a learned and holy proge-nitors.  E. ब्राह्मण and फक् affs.
ब्राह्मणीगामिन्: ब्राह्मणीगामिन् m. (-मी) The gallant of a woman of the Brāhminical tribe or the wife of a Brāhman.  E. ब्राह्मणी a female Brāhman. and गामिन् who goes to or with.
ब्राह्मण्य: ब्राह्मण्य m. (-ण्यः) The planet SATURN. 	 n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. An assembly of Brāh-mans. 	 2. The state, quality or business of a Brāhman, Brāhman-hood.  E. ब्रह्मन् and यञ् aff.; or ब्राह्मन and यत् aff.
ब्राह्मदेया: ब्राह्मदेया f. (-या) A girl to be wedded by the Brāhma form.  E. ब्राह्म and देय to be given.

ब्राह्मिका: ब्राह्मिका f. (-का) A shrub, (Siphonanthus Indica.)  E. ब्राह्मी and कन् aff.
ब्राह्मीपुत्त्र: ब्राह्मीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of a woman married according to the Brāhma form.  E. ब्राह्मी and पुत्त्र a son.
ब्राह्म्य: ब्राह्म्य n. (-ह्म्यं) 	 1. The worship or veneration of Brāhmans, considered as one of the great sacraments. 	 2. Astonishments.  E. ब्रह्म and ष्यञ् aff.
ब्राह्महुत: ब्राह्महुत n. (-तं) Respect shown to guests, especially to Brāhmans, hos-pitality.  E. ब्राह्म्य and हुत sacrifice.
ब्रुवत्: ब्रुवत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Speaking, saying.  E. ब्रु to speak, शतृ aff.
ब्रूवाण: ब्रूवाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Speaking, saying.  E. ब्रू to speak, शानच् aff.
